title: useOptimistic
description:
Implement an optimistic update hook. `update(newVal, asyncFn)` immediately sets `value` to `newVal`, then awaits `asyncFn`. If `asyncFn` rejects, `value` reverts to the previous value. While awaiting, `isUpdating` is `true`.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { value, update, isUpdating } = useOptimistic('initial');
await update('new', () => saveToServer('new')); // value = 'new' immediately
// if saveToServer rejects, value reverts to 'initial'
```
ai_context: Common mistake: using `const previous = value` inside update — if the component re-renders between calls, value holds the optimistic value, not the last server-confirmed value. Use a ref to track the committed value. Also: forgetting to re-throw the error after reverting, which hides failures from the caller.
